ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface area with a contrast ratio of approximately 92% dark to 8% high-intensity (white) pixels localized on distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity dark pigment across both lobes; high-contrast white pixel clusters (0,0 to 0.1,0.2 normalized) on the outer lateral tips and recurring along the trailing edge peaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center; estimated vertex angle of 48 degrees with high-contrast separation between lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 10-25 pixels across the entire trailing edge boundary; sharp jagged peaks corresponding to darker pigment areas.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct upward concave curvature extending symmetrically from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated on the left and right distal tips (barnacle colonies) and scattered along the upper serrated boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel, light-grey linear streaks detected on the mid-section of the right lobe, oriented diagonally (45 degrees) relative to the horizontal water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (high-intensity nodes) on the lateral tips and along the trailing edge; parallel rake-mark scars on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Water droplet spray/splash (high-intensity white pixels) at the lower central boundary where the fluke meets the water line.
